desc.en: This bone is called a dragon bone due to its sheer size. It's a valuable item that fetches high prices, but the market is also filled with counterfeits. Due to its superior strength, it is also used as a high-class material for buildings and ships.
desc.ja: その巨大さから竜骨と呼ばれる骨。高額で取引される貴重なものだが、市場には偽物も数多く存在する。強度に優れ、高級な建物や船の材料にも使われることがある
